# Trottins
Trottins become hungry and thirsty quickly. They are slower than other humanoids and have a distinctive accent. They leave hoofprints behind. Their critical health threshold is higher than normal, as is their stamina critical threshold.
They take [color=#1e90ff]20% less blunt and slashing damage[/color], as well as [color=#1e90ff]20% less cold damage[/color].
